title: Observability: wolfCrypt raw error code lost at fd.c logging boundary
description: fd.c logs the already-translated kernel errno (e.g. -5/-22) at write/finalize/set_iv/sign/verify/agree error paths, not the original wolfCrypt integer. The provider translates and logs the raw wolfCrypt code at pr_err_ratelimited, but with only __func__ context — no algo name, no provider name. The fd.c log has algo+provider but only the translated code. A support engineer reading dmesg cannot correlate the two messages or recover the original wolfCrypt error number from the fd.c line alone. Example: wc_AesCbcEncrypt returns -165 (AES_EAX_AUTH_E), xlat_err maps it to -EIO, fd.c logs 'write(cbc(aes)/wolfssl): update failed: -5' — the -165 is gone.
